verdict.rationale: Productboard's API docs mention 'editor documents' and product document boards with document templates and comments, and Figma embeds are listed among its integrations. That points to some in-app document editing with embedded content. Nothing in the pack describes rich text formatting, custom components, or using these documents for changelog or help content. Missing for 10: documented rich text formatting capabilities, custom/reusable editor components, changelog and help-content publishing use cases, hands-on or independent corroboration.
